description: Who may write a protected org-membership record (0.5.5.3 O1a).

agents.work org: author must be the space owner (an admin may approve where the role source resolves one); the agent's owner alone is refused
agents.personal org: author and row principal must both be the space owner

notes: Admission reads only the document id and the envelope author; it never trusts the record body.
A row whose agent URI names another owner is refused when parsed, not normalized.
